provenance.paper_title: UI-KOBE: Knowledge-Oriented Behavior Exploration for Lightweight Graph-Guided GUI Agents

evidence.section: Full paper: Runtime Memory and Task Progress
evidence.paraphrase: Autonomous exploration creates UI-state nodes and executable transition edges used as runtime guidance.

evidence.section: Full paper: Runtime Memory and Task Progress
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, UI-KOBE applies LLM-mediated memory editing to app knowledge graph; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): Runtime memory records completed instructions, facts, and recent observations for later GUI steps; this is persistent inference-time editing under a fixed policy. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
